newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CNMV suspends trading in Fosforera shares.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CNMV suspends trading in Fosforera shares.

text.p: Spanish stock market watchdog CNMV said on Thursday it had suspended trading in shares of chemicals group Fosforera.

"(The CNMV) has suspended as a precautionary measure trade in the shares and other assets of Grupo Fosforera due to circumstances that could disrupt the normal progress of operations in the quoted shares," the CNMV said in a statement.
In a statement sent to the CMNV, Fosforera said it had suspended payments.

"Due to unfavourable market conditions, especially in the food sector, and the limited and exhausted resources of the company, especially due to the attitude adopted by certain creditors, we have had to adopt the difficult decision to suspend payments," the company said in a statement.
Fosforera said, however, it had succeeded in reducing the group's financial debt by more than nine billion pesetas as a result of a thorough financial restructuring in the last two years.
